name: B&H Photo Video Shop Used (refurbished workstation GPU channel)
price_basis: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition (OEM), used, B&H, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03, against $17,499.00 for the same SKU new on the same date.
notes: Recorded because the discount structure here is the opposite of the used consumer GPU market and that is the actionable finding: the RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q used listing is $16,623.95 against $17,499.00 new, a 5.0% discount, and the RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell is $3,002.95 used against $3,299.99 new, 9.0%. Workstation cards depreciate slowly because they are bought on certification and VRAM, not on price per frame. Contrast with Micro Center, where a refurbished Arc B580 goes for 42% under the new price. If you want the used-market discount on an inference card, buy the consumer part; if you want 96 GB of ECC GDDR7, expect single-digit percentage savings.
